messages.content: Write 3 paragraphs or more. (Make paragraph breaks clear.) Every divider line must be exactly: "=====". Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. Use 5 emojis or fewer. Do not write anything before "Fraud can bring"; start the response with it.

Can you explain to me why there is so much fraud in the world? No divider lines between paragraphs. Your output must begin with: "Fraud can bring". Do not use fewer than 6 emojis. Do not use fewer than 3 paragraphs. (Separate paragraphs clearly.)
